brand.name: Willow Creek Family Dental
brand.descriptor: A family and cosmetic dental practice in Northeast Portland offering preventive, restorative and cosmetic care for the whole family.

text.eyebrow: Family and cosmetic dentistry, NE Portland
text.heading: Gentle dental care for every stage of your family's smile
text.body: Willow Creek Family Dental: preventive care, restorative dentistry and cosmetic dentistry for NE Portland families since 2009, with same-week appointments for new patients.

text.heading: Services and treatments
text.body: From a first cleaning to a full smile plan, our team walks you through every option before we start.

items.title: Preventive care
items.body: Cleanings, exams and digital X-rays for every age, twice a year.

items.title: Restorative dentistry
items.body: Fillings, crowns and bridges using tooth-colored materials.

items.title: Cosmetic dentistry
items.body: Whitening, bonding and porcelain veneers, planned around your smile.

text.heading: Meet your providers
text.body: Our team brings preventive, restorative and cosmetic dentistry experience to every family that visits Willow Creek.

items.name: Dr. Elena Marsh, DDS
items.credential: General and cosmetic dentistry, University of Washington School of Dentistry, practicing since 2008

items.name: Dr. Priya Anand, DMD
items.credential: Restorative dentistry, Oregon Health & Science University, practicing since 2015

items.name: Sofia Reyes, RDH
items.credential: Registered dental hygienist, Pacific University, on staff since 2019

text.heading: What to expect at your visit
text.body: Check-in and a short health history, then an exam, a cleaning and a clear plan before any work starts.

items.title: Check-in and history
items.body: A short health history at check-in.

items.title: Cleaning and plan
items.body: A cleaning, then a clear plan, with costs explained up front.

text.heading: Ready to book?
text.body: New patients can book online or call our front desk.

items.quote: Dr. Marsh explained every step before she started. First dentist visit in years that didn't feel rushed.
items.name: Katie R.

items.quote: Sofia is fantastic with my kids. They actually look forward to their cleanings now.
items.name: Marcus D.

items.quote: Got a same-week appointment for a cracked filling and the front desk made it painless.
items.name: Anh T.

text.heading: Insurance and costs
text.body: We work with most major PPO plans and offer a straightforward cash-pay option for routine care.

items.name: Most major PPO plans
items.detail: Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife; our front desk verifies benefits before billing.

items.name: New patient cleaning & exam
items.detail: Cleaning, exam and digital X-rays for patients without insurance.

items.question: Do you see new patients?
items.answer: Yes, we're accepting new patients of every age and usually offer a same-week first appointment.

items.question: Do you offer emergency appointments?
items.answer: We hold same-day slots for urgent issues like a cracked tooth or a lost filling; call our front desk first thing.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes, free patient parking is available directly behind the building.

text.tagline: Family dental care for NE Portland since 2009.
